label: Menshen system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Menshen locus represented by NsnA, NsnB, and NsnC profile choices that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Menshen branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual nsnA, nsnB, or nsnC genes, NsnA, NsnB, or NsnC proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Menshen locus, unresolved Menshen trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
